name: ConCarolinas
blurb: The Carolinas' longest-running science fiction and fantasy convention, with author, artist and media guests of honor in Charlotte.

editions.evidence: Eventeny listing: 'Jun 04, 2027 3:00 PM - Jun 06, 2027 5:00 PM', venue '8629 J M Keynes Dr., Charlotte, North Carolina 28262' (the Hilton Charlotte University Place)

notes: The official homepage is still titled/dated for the prior edition ('ConCarolinas 2026 ... May 29 – May 31, 2026', with named Guests of Honor for that show); that edition is before the research window, so its guest names were not carried over. Eventeny confirms the next edition is June 4-6, 2027 and that only a general 'Guest Application 2027' (panelist tracks, deadline Nov 28, 2026) is open — no named guests of honor yet. Could not find a working current guests page on the official site: the nav has no Guests link and /at-the-con/guests/ 301-redirects to a stale 2018 blog post, so guestsPage is left blank.
